analysis.reason: RSI 37.4에서 39.1로 상승하며 과매도 구간 탈출 시도 중. MACD 히스토그램 역시 -1.1137에서 -0.7599로 개선되며 약세 전환 신호 미약. ADX 32.8로 뚜렷한 추세는 유지되나, -DI가 37.9로 +DI 14.2보다 우위에 있어 하락 압력 잔존. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 0.31로 매우 위축된 상태에서 방향성 탐색 구간. 15일 연속 관망 판독 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI attempts to exit oversold, moving from 37.4 to 39.1. MACD histogram also improves from -1.1137 to -0.7599, showing a weak signal of trend reversal. ADX at 32.8 indicates a clear trend, but -DI at 37.9 remains above +DI at 14.2, suggesting lingering downward pressure. Volume ratio at 0.31 of the 5-day average is highly contracted, indicating a range-bound search for direction. Wait-and-see read maintained for 15 consecutive sessions.

· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-1.1137→-0.7599): 약세 지속이나 개선 중, 데드크로스 이후 약세 수렴 구간

[지지·저항 구조]

[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.31배): 매우 위축된 거래량, 움직임 신뢰도 하락

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($285.74) vs SMA5($284.87)/SMA20($291.20)/SMA50($294.24): Short-term trend above, mid-term trend below.
· Position vs SMA100($290.84)/SMA200($273.73): Mixed medium-to-long-term trend, maintaining strength above SMA200.
· 52-week position (74.5%) + Current price range near historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (37.4→39.1): Attempting to exit oversold territory, weak upward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-1.1137→-0.7599): Weakness persists but improving, in a bearish convergence phase post-death cross.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Band $291.20): Sideways near the middle band, band width contracted to 6.90%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($277.62): Based on 52-week low and lower Bollinger Band.
· Swing Resistance ($287.58): Approaching 5-day high and Pivot R1.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern: 5-day low ($281.03) > 20-day low ($281.03) indicates no Higher Low pattern formed, continuing sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.31x): Highly contracted volume, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis: Sideways within accumulation phase, searching for direction, meeting conditions for observation.
analysis.patternNote: 5일 저가와 20일 저가가 동일한 수준으로, 명확한 Higher Low 패턴 미형성. 볼린저밴드 중단 부근에서 횡보하며 방향성 탐색 구간 지속.
analysis.patternNoteEn: The 5-day and 20-day lows are at the same level, indicating no clear Higher Low pattern formation. Sideways movement continues near the middle Bollinger Band, in a phase of directional exploration.
